_: Skin surface lipid (sebum): a thin film, drawn by the bench as a smooth dielectric COAT over the skin (0.6-1.4 um on the forehead, far below a path step). Sources: the project's materials research note GAPS_RESEARCH.md 6, research/skin_moisture.md O8-O9. Materials foundation lane 2026-11-07. v2 (world lane, 2026-11-07): contact / deform / thermal added from the old `mechanics` block; layers, surface untouched.

thickness_mm.src: skin_moisture.md O8: forehead 60-140 ug/cm2 ~ 0.6-1.4 um; forearm ~7 nm

extra_mua_per_cm.src: essentially clear, may be faintly yellow; no spectrum found (GAPS 6); at 1 um any tint is invisible

n.src: no measured whole-sebum n; volume mix of triglyceride ~1.47 (57.5 %), wax ester ~1.465 (26 %), squalene 1.499 (12 %, CRC via skin_moisture.md O9)

alpha.src: a film > 0.5 um hides fine steps (research/hair_styling.md:83, on hair); on skin it fills the finest relief but follows the furrows; 0.08 reasoned, to be read from oily-skin photos

viscosity_mPa_s.src: MOTWANI01 (site columns garbled in extraction: per-site values uncertain); ~35-60 at skin temperature (D)

spreading.v: spreads on skin (surface tension below skin's surface energy); no angle found

water_on_sebum_skin.v: sebum makes skin MORE wettable by water (angle forehead 57-73 vs forearm 80-91)

effect.v: a sebum film lowers skin's friction against hard smooth counterfaces only slightly at body amounts (0.6-1.4 um on the forehead); added oils (cosmetic) lubricate more; skin with sebum reads higher friction in some studies (sebum + hydration covary)
effect.src: SKIN_SEBUM_FRIC qualitative; no clean sebum-only friction number found

permeation.v: lipophilic: it does not wet water-filled pores; it wicks into hair (along the cuticle) and fabric (cotton, polyester) and stains them; it softens and plasticises the stratum corneum surface lipids
permeation.src: ANON_E from its low surface tension (23-25 mN/m: it wets almost every solid) and composition

v.film_on_surface: the film's own thickness (layers / film values)

collision_thickness_mm.src: ANON_E solver convention: a liquid has no skin of its own; it keeps a no-penetration boundary at solids

model.v: incompressible: no stiffness ramp; a pressure projection (or weakly compressible SPH with numerical sound speed >= 10x the max flow speed) keeps it out of solids and out of itself
model.src: bulk modulus (water 2.2 GPa: effectively incompressible at body speeds)

boundary_wetting.v: the contact angle per pair (pairs/world.json wetting) sets the meniscus at a solid

restitution.src: RICHARD02 / DEGENNES04: drops stick and spread on wettable solids; bounce only on (super)hydrophobic ones

response_time_ms.src: RICHARD02 tau = 2.6 sqrt(rho R^3/gamma) with rho 905, gamma 0.024 N/m

wave_speed_m_s.src: sound ~ water's (CRC; oils ~1450); capillary-wave phase speed sqrt(2 pi gamma/(rho lambda)) at lambda 1 mm

damping_ratio.v: viscous: set by viscosity_mPa_s (no separate damping)

model.src: ANON_E: triglyceride-rich liquids are Newtonian above their melting range; below ~30 C a solid fraction separates (MOTWANI01) and it turns paste-like

viscosity_mPa_s.src: MOTWANI01 (site columns garbled in extraction: per-site values uncertain); ~35-60 at skin temperature (D)

phase.v: discontinuity at 30 C; starts freezing ~30 C, solid 15-17 C, melts 33-35 C

emissivity.src: not found: a um film is IR-thin; the skin below sets the emission (~0.98)

composition.src: PICARDO09 (classic Downing / Strauss values, recalled, unverified)

effect_on_skin.v: lowers directional reflectance 400-600 nm, raises it above; the shine comes from the smooth air-sebum surface over rougher skin
effect_on_skin.src: SEBUM_DIRREF23, KOHLI21 (GAPS 6); forehead gloss +21 % from 0.5 to 6 h after washing, glossy area x4.1 (Jang 2018, skin_specular.json)

cold_paste.src: MOTWANI01: below ~30 C a solid fraction separates; solid at 15-17 C

spread_shine.src: ANON_E: hours after washing, forehead gloss rises (Jang 2018 in skin_specular.json); a thicker, smoother film; values to be read from oily-skin photos

MOTWANI01.cite: Motwani MR, Rhein LD, Zatz JL. Differential scanning calorimetry studies of sebum models. J Cosmet Sci 52:211-224 (2001), Table I (via GAPS 6)
MOTWANI01.lic: SCC library, access-controlled; numbers used as facts

MAVON97.cite: Mavon A et al. Colloids Surf B 8:147-155 (1997) (via GAPS 5/6): sebum raises skin surface free energy

GAPS.cite: Project research note the project's materials research note GAPS_RESEARCH.md (11-07), which carries the primary citations (IAPWS14/08, MAVON97, ELKHYAT04, MOTWANI01, SONNER15, SCHIPPER07, ERMPS18, DAIMON07, POPEFRY97)
GAPS.lic: project record; primary sources' terms listed there

OILS_TYPICAL.cite: Typical vegetable/triglyceride oil thermal properties: k ~0.16-0.17 W/mK, cp ~1.9-2.0 kJ/kgK (e.g. Engineering ToolBox / CRC). Used as an analogue for sebum
OILS_TYPICAL.lic: free web reference; numbers used as facts

SKIN_SEBUM_FRIC.cite: Skin friction with surface lipid / oily skin: Derler & Gerhardt, Tribol Lett 45:1-27 (2012) review; Cua AB, Wilhelm K-P, Maibach HI. Br J Dermatol 123:473 (1990): friction correlates with hydration and sebum. Recalled qualitative

ANON_E.cite: Estimate made in this lane; the reason is given in each src

PICARDO09.cite: Picardo M et al. Sebaceous gland lipids. Dermato-Endocrinology 1:68-71 (2009) (via GAPS 6)
PICARDO09.lic: not checked; numbers used as facts

SEBUM_DIRREF23.cite: The influence of sebum on directional reflectance of the skin. Appl Sci 13:2838 (2023)

KOHLI21.cite: Kohli I et al. Arch Dermatol Res (2021) PMID 32270323

DAIMON07.cite: Daimon M, Masumura A. Appl Opt 46:3811 (2007), via refractiveindex.info

RICHARD02.cite: Richard D, Clanet C, Quere D. Contact time of a bouncing drop. Nature 417:811 (2002): tau = 2.6 sqrt(rho R^3 / gamma), independent of impact speed

DEGENNES04.cite: de Gennes P-G, Brochard-Wyart F, Quere D. Capillarity and Wetting Phenomena. Springer (2004): capillary length, Bond number, Tanner spreading

CRC.cite: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics (any recent edition): standard property tables for water, ice, air, oils. Values recalled as standard table values, not re-checked line by line this session
CRC.lic: copyright, paywalled; individual physical constants used as facts, no table copied
